description: Cases the firm has verified and approved for use in memos. Holdings are one-line summaries.

cases.holding: Established judicial review: courts may strike down laws that conflict with the Constitution.
Racial segregation in public schools violates the Equal Protection Clause.
The exclusionary rule applies to the states: evidence from unconstitutional searches is inadmissible.
States must provide counsel to indigent defendants facing felony charges.

cases.case: New York Times Co. v. Sullivan
cases.holding: Public officials suing for defamation must prove actual malice.
Statements from custodial interrogation are inadmissible unless the suspect was first warned of their rights.
Police may stop and frisk on reasonable suspicion that a person is armed and involved in crime.
Advocacy is protected unless it is directed to inciting imminent lawless action and likely to produce it.
Federal courts sitting in diversity apply state substantive law.

cases.case: Palsgraf v. Long Island Railroad Co.
cases.holding: A defendant's duty of care extends only to foreseeable plaintiffs.
